use.en: the recommended daily amount is 10 g. Stir 10 g of powder (2 scoops) into a glass of water (200 mL) once a day, stir until dissolved and drink. For total precision we suggest weighing. With 10 g of powder, you consume 5 g of Naticol collagen peptides.

use.it: la quantità giornaliera raccomandata è di 10 g. Mescolare 10 g di polvere (2 misurini) in un bicchiere d’acqua (200 ml) una volta al giorno, mescolare fino a scioglimento e bere. Recommended daily dose: the recommended daily amount is 10 g. Stir 10 g of powder (2 scoops) into a glass of water (200 mL) once a day, stir until dissolved and drink.
